packageRules.description: dcgm-exporter 4.9 renames the metrics and changes units (DCGM 4.7 names); the vmalert rules and dashboards use the 4.8 names. Lift when they move
Group CI scanner tools into one PR
DefenseClaw bump needs `defenseclaw-bundle.py sync` on dgx-1 before merge
prBodyNotes: Run `.github/scripts/defenseclaw-bundle.py sync` on dgx-1, port any printed diffs, push to this branch.

packageRules.description: Open WebUI, the base of the Ask Me overlay (cluster/apps/open-webui/image/Dockerfile). The PR's CI builds the overlay, so a patch that no longer applies fails it. After the merge build-sign pushes ghcr.io/nikghodki/open-webui:<tag>-askme.<n>; pin its digest in cluster/apps/open-webui/open-webui.yaml (runbooks/open-webui.md, Ask Me overlay)
prBodyNotes: CI step "Open WebUI overlay builds on its pinned base" applies the Ask Me patch to this version; if it fails, update `cluster/apps/open-webui/image/patch_branding.py`. On a new upstream version reset `# askme-revision:` to 1. After merge: take the digest from the build-sign run summary and pin it in `cluster/apps/open-webui/open-webui.yaml` (back up webui.db first: runbooks/open-webui.md, Upgrade).
